newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan seeks around 120,000 T U.S. wheat -trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordan seeks around 120,000 T U.S. wheat -trade.

text.p: Jordan is seeking around $21 million of U.S. wheat -- about 120,000 tonnes -- financed under the PL 480 programme, traders said on Tuesday.
They said offers must be received by Thursday and the result would be announced on the same day by Jordan's Supply Minister Hani Mulqi, who is currently in the U.S.
The freight tender award will be announced at the same time as the wheat tender, they said.
The wheat is expected to be shipped in two lots for delivery in the second half of May and second half of June. The exact quantities purchased will depend on the prices Jordan pays for the wheat.
